options.name: activity_tracking
options.description: Sets activity tracking state of the volume. Only supported with REST and requires ONTAP 9.10 or later version.

options.name: aggr_list
options.description: an array of names of aggregates to be used for FlexGroup constituents.

options.name: aggr_list_multiplier
options.description: The number of times to iterate over the aggregates listed with the aggr_list parameter when creating a FlexGroup.

options.name: aggregate_name
options.description: The name of the aggregate the flexvol should exist on. Cannot be set when using the C(nas_application_template) option.

options.name: analytics
options.description: Sets file system analytics state of the volume. Only supported with REST and requires ONTAP 9.8 or later version. Cannot enable analytics for volume that contains luns.

options.name: anti_ransomware
options.description: Anti-ransomware related information of the volume. Only supported with REST and requires ONTAP 9.10 or later.

options.name: atime_update
options.description: This is an advanced option, the default is True. If false, prevent the update of inode access times when a file is read. This value is useful for volumes with extremely high read traffic, since it prevents writes to the inode file for the volume from contending with reads from other files. This field should be used carefully. That is, use this field when you know in advance that the correct access time for inodes will not be needed for files on that volume. This option is supported in REST for O

options.name: auto_provision_as
options.description: Automatically provision a FlexGroup volume.

options.name: auto_remap_luns
options.description: Flag to control automatic map of LUNs.

options.name: cert_filepath
options.description: path to SSL client cert file (.pem). not supported with python 2.6.

options.name: check_interval
options.description: The amount of time in seconds to wait between checks of a volume to see if it has moved successfully.

options.name: comment
options.description: Sets a comment associated with the volume.

options.name: compression
options.description: Whether to enable compression for the volume (HDD and Flash Pool aggregates). If this option is not present, it is automatically set to true if inline_compression is true.

options.name: cutover_action
options.description: Specifies the action to be taken for cutover. Possible values are 'abort_on_failure', 'defer_on_failure', 'force' and 'wait'. Default is 'defer_on_failure'.

options.name: efficiency_policy
options.description: Allows a storage efficiency policy to be set on volume creation.

options.name: encrypt
options.description: Whether or not to enable Volume Encryption. If not present, ONTAP defaults to false at volume creation. Changing encrypt value after creation requires ONTAP 9.3 or later.

options.name: export_policy
options.description: Name of the export policy. Mutually exclusive with nfs_access suboption in nas_application_template.

options.name: feature_flags
options.description: Enable or disable a new feature. This can be used to enable an experimental feature or disable a new feature that breaks backward compatibility. Supported keys and values are subject to change without notice.  Unknown keys are ignored.

options.name: force_ontap_version
options.description: Override the cluster ONTAP version when using REST. The behavior is undefined if the version does not match the target cluster. This is provided as a work-around when the cluster version cannot be read because of permission issues. See https://github.com/ansible-collections/netapp.ontap/wiki/Known-issues. This should be in the form 9.10 or 9.10.1 with each element being an integer number. When C(use_rest) is set to auto, this may force a switch to ZAPI based on the version and platform capabilit

options.name: force_restore
options.description: If this field is set to "true", the Snapshot copy is restored even if the volume has one or more newer Snapshot copies which are currently used as reference Snapshot copy by SnapMirror. If a restore is done in this situation, this will cause future SnapMirror transfers to fail. Option should only be used along with snapshot_restore.

options.name: force_unmap_luns
options.description: Flag to control automatic unmap of LUNs.

options.name: from_name
options.description: Name of the existing volume to be renamed to name.

options.name: from_vserver
options.description: The source vserver of the volume is rehosted.

options.name: granular_data
options.description: State of granular data on the volume. Only FlexGroup volumes support this feature. Once enabled, this setting can only be disabled by restoring a Snapshot copy. Only supported with REST and requires ONTAP 9.12 or later.

options.name: group_id
options.description: The UNIX group ID for the volume. The default value is 0 ('root').

options.name: hostname
options.description: The hostname or IP address of the ONTAP instance.

options.name: http_port
options.description: Override the default port (80 or 443) with this port

options.name: https
options.description: Enable and disable https. Ignored when using REST as only https is supported. Ignored when using SSL certificate authentication as it requires SSL.

options.name: inline_compression
options.description: Whether to enable inline compression for the volume (HDD and Flash Pool aggregates, AFF platforms).

options.name: is_infinite
options.description: Set True if the volume is an Infinite Volume. Deleting an infinite volume is asynchronous.

options.name: is_online
options.description: Whether the specified volume is online, or not.

options.name: junction_path
options.description: Junction path of the volume. To unmount, use junction path C('').

options.name: key_filepath
options.description: path to SSL client key file.

options.name: lambda_config
options.description: Configuration parameters for AWS Lambda proxy functionality. These option and suboptions are only supported with REST.

options.name: language
options.description: Language to use for Volume Default uses SVM language Possible values   Language c                 POSIX ar                Arabic cs                Czech da                Danish de                German en                English en_us             English (US) es                Spanish fi                Finnish fr                French he                Hebrew hr                Croatian hu                Hungarian it                Italian ja                Japanese euc-j ja_v1             Japane

options.name: large_size_enabled
options.description: Indicates if the support for large FlexVol volumes and large files is enabled on this volume.

options.name: logical_space_enforcement
options.description: This optionally specifies whether to perform logical space accounting on the volume. When space is enforced logically, ONTAP enforces volume settings such that all the physical space saved by the storage efficiency features will be calculated as used. This is only supported with REST.

options.name: logical_space_reporting
options.description: This optionally specifies whether to report space logically on the volume. When space is reported logically, ONTAP reports the volume space such that all the physical space saved by the storage efficiency features are also reported as used. This is only supported with REST.

options.name: max_files
options.description: The maximum number of files (inodes) for user-visible data allowed on the volume. Note - ONTAP allocates a slightly different value, for instance 3990 when asking for 4000. Tp preserve idempotency, small variations in size are ignored.

options.name: max_wait_time
options.description: Volume move and encryption operations might take longer time to complete. With C(wait_for_completion) set, module will wait for time set in this option for volume move and encryption to complete. If time exipres, module exit and the operation may still be running. Default is set to 10 minutes.

options.name: name
options.description: The name of the volume to manage.

options.name: nas_application_template
options.description: additional options when using the application/applications REST API to create a volume. the module is using ZAPI by default, and switches to REST if any suboption is present. create a FlexVol by default. create a FlexGroup if C(auto_provision_as) is set and C(FlexCache) option is not present. create a FlexCache if C(flexcache) option is present.

options.name: nvfail_enabled
options.description: If true, the controller performs additional work at boot and takeover times if it finds that there has been any potential data loss in the volume's constituents due to an NVRAM failure. The volume's constituents would be put in a special state called 'in-nvfailed-state' such that protocol access is blocked. This will cause the client applications to crash and thus prevent access to stale data. To get out of this situation, the admin needs to manually clear the 'in-nvfailed-state' on the volume's

options.name: ontapi
options.description: The ontap api version to use

options.name: password
options.description: Password for the specified user.

options.name: percent_snapshot_space
options.description: Amount of space reserved for snapshot copies of the volume.

options.name: preserve_lun_ids
options.description: If this field is set to "true", LUNs in the volume being restored will remain mapped and their identities preserved such that host connectivity will not be disrupted during the restore operation. I/O's to the LUN will be fenced during the restore operation by placing the LUNs in an unavailable state. Once the restore operation has completed, hosts will be able to resume I/O access to the LUNs. Option should only be used along with snapshot_restore.

options.name: qos_adaptive_policy_group
options.description: Specifies a QoS adaptive policy group to be set on volume.

options.name: qos_policy_group
options.description: Specifies a QoS policy group to be set on volume.

options.name: size
options.description: The size of the volume in (size_unit). Required when C(state=present).

options.name: size_change_threshold
options.description: Percentage in size change to trigger a resize. When this parameter is greater than 0, a difference in size between what is expected and what is configured is ignored if it is below the threshold. For instance, the nas application allocates a larger size than specified to account for overhead. When using C(nas_application_template), if the overhead size difference is within the threshold, the module updates the size parameter to match the allocated size for idempotency in subsequent runs. If the

options.name: size_unit
options.description: The unit used to interpret the size parameter.

options.name: sizing_method
options.description: Represents the method to modify the size of a FlexGroup. use_existing_resources - Increases or decreases the size of the FlexGroup by increasing or decreasing the size of the current FlexGroup resources. add_new_resources - Increases the size of the FlexGroup by adding new resources. This is limited to two new resources per available aggregate. This is only supported if REST is enabled (ONTAP 9.6 or later) and only for FlexGroups.  ONTAP defaults to use_existing_resources.

options.name: snapdir_access
options.description: This is an advanced option, the default is False. Enable the visible '.snapshot' directory that is normally present at system internal mount points. This value also turns on access to all other '.snapshot' directories in the volume. This option is supported in REST for ONTAP 9.13.1 or later with ONTAP collection version 22.8.0 or later.

options.name: snaplock
options.description: Starting with ONTAP 9.10.1, snaplock.type is set at the volume level. The other suboptions can be set or modified when using REST on earlier versions of ONTAP. These option and suboptions are only supported with REST.

options.name: snapshot_auto_delete
options.description: A dictionary for the auto delete options and values. All the above mentioned options except 'destroy_list' are supported in REST for ONTAP 9.13.1 or later with ONTAP collection version 22.8.0 or later.

options.name: snapshot_locking
options.description: Specifies whether or not snapshot copy locking is enabled on the volume. Only supported with REST and requires ONTAP 9.12 or later.

options.name: snapshot_policy
options.description: The name of the snapshot policy. The default policy name is 'default'. If present, this will set the protection_type when using C(nas_application_template).

options.name: snapshot_restore
options.description: Name of snapshot to restore from. Not supported on Infinite Volume.

options.name: space_guarantee
options.description: Space guarantee style for the volume. The file setting is no longer supported.

options.name: space_slo
options.description: Specifies the space SLO type for the volume. The space SLO type is the Service Level Objective for space management for the volume. The space SLO value is used to enforce existing volume settings so that sufficient space is set aside on the aggregate to meet the space SLO. This parameter is not supported on Infinite Volumes.

options.name: state
options.description: Whether the specified volume should exist or not.

options.name: tags
options.description: Tags are an optional way to track the uses of a resource. Tag values must be formatted as key:value strings, example ["team:csi", "environment:test"]

options.name: tiering_minimum_cooling_days
options.description: Determines how many days must pass before inactive data in a volume using the Auto or Snapshot-Only policy is considered cold and eligible for tiering. This option is only supported in REST 9.8 or later.

options.name: tiering_object_tags
options.description: This parameter specifies tags of a volume for objects stored on a FabricPool-enabled aggregate. Each tag is a key,value pair and should be in the format "key=value". A maximum of 4 tags are allowed per volume. To remove all existing tiering object tags, specify an empty list as the parameter value.

options.name: tiering_policy
options.description: The tiering policy that is to be associated with the volume. This policy decides whether the blocks of a volume will be tiered to the capacity tier. snapshot-only policy allows tiering of only the volume snapshot copies not associated with the active file system. auto policy allows tiering of both snapshot and active file system user data to the capacity tier. backup policy on DP volumes allows all transferred user data blocks to start in the capacity tier. all is the REST equivalent for backup.

options.name: time_out
options.description: With ZAPI - time to wait for Flexgroup creation, modification, or deletion in seconds. With REST - time to wait for any volume creation, modification, or deletion in seconds. Error out if task is not completed in defined time. With ZAPI - if 0, the request is asynchronous. Default is set to 3 minutes. Use C(max_wait_time) and C(wait_for_completion) for volume move and encryption operations.

options.name: type
options.description: The volume type, either read-write (RW) or data-protection (DP).

options.name: unix_permissions
options.description: Unix permission bits in octal or symbolic format. For example, 0 is equivalent to ------------, 777 is equivalent to ---rwxrwxrwx,both formats are accepted. The valid octal value ranges between 0 and 777 inclusive.

options.name: use_lambda
options.description: Specifies if AWS Lambda proxy functionality should be used to connect to the ONTAP system. Supported only with REST.

options.name: use_rest
options.description: Whether to use REST or ZAPI. always -- will always use the REST API if the module supports REST. A warning is issued if the module does not support REST. An error is issued if a module option is not supported in REST. never -- will always use ZAPI if the module supports ZAPI.  An error may be issued if a REST option is not supported in ZAPI. auto -- will try to use the REST API if the module supports REST and modules options are supported.  Reverts to ZAPI otherwise.

options.name: user_id
options.description: The UNIX user ID for the volume. The default value is 0 ('root').

options.name: username
options.description: This can be a Cluster-scoped or SVM-scoped account, depending on whether a Cluster-level or SVM-level API is required. For more information, please read the documentation U(https://docs.netapp.com/us-en/ontap/authentication/create-svm-user-accounts-task.html). Two authentication methods are supported 1. Basic authentication, using username and password. 2. SSL certificate authentication, using a ssl client cert file, and optionally a private key file. To use a certificate, the certificate must h

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: If set to C(no), the SSL certificates will not be validated. This should only set to C(False) used on personally controlled sites using self-signed certificates.

options.name: vol_full_threshold_percent
options.description: Specifies the percentage at which the volume is considered full, and above which a critical EMS error will be generated. The default value is 98%. The maximum value for this option is 100%. Setting this threshold to 0 disables the volume full space alerts. Supported only with REST and requires ONTAP 9.9 or later.

options.name: vol_nearly_full_threshold_percent
options.description: Specifies the percentage at which the volume is considered nearly full, and above which an EMS warning will be generated. The default value is 95%. The maximum value for this option is 99%. Setting this threshold to 0 disables the volume nearly full space alerts. Supported only with REST and requires ONTAP 9.9 or later.

options.name: volume_security_style
options.description: The security style associated with this volume.

options.name: vserver
options.description: Name of the vserver to use.

options.name: vserver_dr_protection
options.description: Specifies the protection type for the volume in a Vserver DR setup.

options.name: wait_for_completion
options.description: Set this parameter to 'true' for synchronous execution during create (wait until volume status is online) Set this parameter to 'false' for asynchronous execution For asynchronous, execution exits as soon as the request is sent, without checking volume status
